nodes.label: Publish Spine (trigger -> approve -> cron -> FB publish)
nodes.rationale: The core hard rule of the codebase: every content feature must flow through the existing trigger -> approval -> Vercel cron -> platform publish pipeline and must never break it.

nodes.label: Slug-vs-UUID Trap (resolveWorkspaceId)
nodes.rationale: Workspace URLs accept UUID or slug but every table stores the UUID; browser queries filtering workspace_id by the route param silently return zero rows — pages must call an API route that uses resolveWorkspaceId().

nodes.label: Supabase Client Selection Rules (server/admin/browser)
nodes.rationale: createServerSupabaseClient for user-session server code, createAdminClient (service role) for webhooks/cron/trusted server-only code, browser anon client only for RLS-scoped queries.
